headline: 🔴 Cisco SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-76504 exploited and KEV-listed, 📧 Microsoft confirms mass Zimbra CVE-2026-73570 exploitation, 🤖 DIVD names Zammad zero-days as AI agent entry point, 🌐 MikroTik RouterOS pre-auth root RCE CVE-2026-84411, 🌍 WatchGuard Fireware OS BOVPN root RCE batch, 💸 OFAC sanctions Tren de Aragua ATM jackpotting network
summary: An exploited CVSS 9.8 Cisco SD-WAN Manager auth bypass landed in KEV while Microsoft confirmed Zimbra's CVE-2026-73570 as a campaign-scale mail-borne RCE, DIVD named the Zammad zero-days behind its AI-agent breach, and MikroTik plus WatchGuard edge devices got patch-now root RCE advisories.

overrides.why: Slate CATCH-UP: the KEV batch's newest development is Sept 28 (3 days old) and the additions were already covered in the Sept 26 digest; only re-reports since, so dropped.

Score 2.6 under-ranks it: code injection in the BOVPN over TLS client yields root on the perimeter Firebox when the tunnel peer is controlled (CVE-2026-86131), the same batch carries a pre-auth fingerd RCE (CVE-2026-81433), and the product line has recent KEV history via CVE-2025-9242.

Score 2.5 but CloudSEK documents a still-active two-year npm postinstall campaign delivering Overlord RAT and harvesting Discord tokens, browser credentials and wallets; concrete supply chain exposure the burst-weighted score misses.
